// Reproduction artifact, not a production change or a passing closure test.
// Place in internal/runtime/manager/issue2321_projection_probe_test.go and run:
// go test ./internal/runtime/manager -run '^TestIssue2321ConcurrentDiagnosticProjectionProbe$' -count=3 -v
// The barrier models concurrent list snapshots and the existing store CAS.
// On f9bd165b4 all three repetitions emit twice and return one projection conflict.
package manager

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	runtimepipeline "github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/pipeline"
)

type diagnosticProjectionProbeStore struct {
	listed atomic.Int32
	marked atomic.Bool
	both   chan struct{}
}

func (s *diagnosticProjectionProbeStore) ListPendingAgentLifecycleDiagnostics(ctx context.Context, _ int) ([]AgentLifecycleDiagnostic, error) {
	if s.listed.Add(1) == 2 {
		close(s.both)
	}
	select {
	case <-s.both:
		return []AgentLifecycleDiagnostic{{OutboxID: "same-pending-row", AgentID: "agent", EventName: "agent_stopped"}}, nil
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return nil, ctx.Err()
	}
}

func (s *diagnosticProjectionProbeStore) MarkAgentLifecycleDiagnosticProjected(context.Context, string, time.Time) error {
	if !s.marked.CompareAndSwap(false, true) {
		return errors.New("lifecycle diagnostic projection conflict")
	}
	return nil
}

type diagnosticProjectionProbeBus struct {
	resetTestBus
	logs atomic.Int32
}

func (b *diagnosticProjectionProbeBus) LogRuntime(context.Context, runtimepipeline.RuntimeLogEntry) error {
	b.logs.Add(1)
	return nil
}

func TestIssue2321ConcurrentDiagnosticProjectionProbe(t *testing.T) {
	store := &diagnosticProjectionProbeStore{both: make(chan struct{})}
	bus := &diagnosticProjectionProbeBus{}
	manager := &AgentManager{bus: bus, lifecycle: &agentLifecycleCoordinator{}, roles: PersistenceRoles{LifecycleDiagnostics: store}}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	results := make(chan error, 2)
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		go func() { results <- manager.projectLifecycleDiagnostics(ctx) }()
	}
	first, second := <-results, <-results
	if first != nil || second != nil || bus.logs.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("concurrent projection: errors=(%v, %v), emitted=%d, want successful single projection", first, second, bus.logs.Load())
	}
}
